checks.why: a src-layout package is imported by its package name: `from app import lookup` in a test is an import of src/app/__init__.py, so the test file reaches what that import runs

pytest imports tests/conftest.py before every test file under it, so a function that runs while the package is imported (normalise, through the module-level @register) breaks a test file that never imports the package itself
CONTROL: describe runs at no import, so a test file that does not call it is not reached by the import walk
